rules.statement: A tenant who remains in occupation with notice of the purchaser's election to recognize him as a tenant may be regarded as having attorned to the purchaser so as to establish privity of contract between them.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is now a well established principle that a tenant who remains in occupation with notice of the purchaser's election to recognise him as tenant may legitimately be regarded as having attorned to the purchaser so as to establish privity of contract between them"
